positive.title: Package signature, bundle manifest, and source receipts
Engine, identity, trust, and manifest preflight
Exact composite host and client authentication
Exact mlkem768x25519-sha256 KEX and approved AEAD cipher
At least one rekey under the same exact profile
PID-bound authenticated readiness before application transit
Deterministic target payload through the loopback listener
Clean stop, restart, host-key rotation, client-key rotation, revocation, and package upgrade
Second independent client grant to the same host target
Two independent client routes without shared identity or port collision
Real reboot of unless-stopped, manual, and explicit down
Live active-session expiry and revocation at the authority boundary
Material clock rollback removes authorization and closes sessions
Host target change denied while any invite or grant exists
Remote Docker Compose Postgres bound only to host loopback
Canonical Agent Skill published byte-for-byte with version and digest

negative.title: Classical-only KEX, host key, and client key
Malformed, truncated, overlong, trailing-data, and wrong-algorithm keys and messages
Expired, reused, altered, cross-server, and cross-target invites
Shell, exec, subsystem, SFTP, SCP, remote, dynamic, agent, X11, stream-local, and TUN forwarding
Listener collision, process substitution, runtime-directory replacement, and state-file mutation
Failed rekey, engine replacement, receipt drift, code-signature failure, and package tampering
Bounded connection, authentication, channel, and oversized-packet floods
Loss of network, server restart, target refusal, and interrupted enrollment
PID reuse and stop-failure remain non-terminal
Silent grant renewal and silent local-port reassignment
